garrytan.en: AGI is not a singular event but diffuses as personal agents, already present in daily life.
garrytan.zh: AGI 并非一个单一事件，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散，已存在于日常生活中。

garrytan.en: Markdown files and skills are code; clear English can program AI agents, turning them into employees.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 文件和技能即代码；清晰的英语即可编程 AI 智能体，使其成为员工。

garrytan.en: Owning your skill files is crucial; otherwise your job becomes a skill file owned by others.
garrytan.zh: 拥有自己的技能文件至关重要；否则你的工作就会变成他人拥有的技能文件。

garrytan.en: SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; agents replace mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: SaaS 按席位模式可能在 5-10 年内消失；智能体将取代中层管理。

garrytan.en: Society will change slower than expected, taking 20 years, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 社会变化将比预期更慢，需要 20 年，这是积极的。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专门系统和工程师；需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Hopper GPUs remain popular for inference, rental prices rising; GPU lifecycle longer than expected, contrary to rapid depreciation.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：Hopper GPU 在推理中仍受欢迎，租赁价格上涨；GPU 生命周期比预期长，与快速贬值相反。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Industry moving to disaggregated prefill and decode; KV cache management increasingly important; inference merging with training.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：行业走向分离式预填充和解码；KV 缓存管理日益重要；推理与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin become ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 GPU 如 Rubin 变得类似 ASIC，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人，关键在于多样化数据以及预训练加微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following of open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似于强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需要更少错误，通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为单一通用模型在下游任务上可媲美或超越微调专家模型。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient for learning physical tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不足以学习物理任务。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability and first principles thinking are key to making life multiplanetary.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全可重复使用和第一性原理思维是实现多行星生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; war is part of human nature.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，战争是人性的一部分。

elon.en: Neuralink aims to solve neurological damage and enhance human-AI symbiosis; AI must be truth-seeking.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 旨在解决神经损伤并增强人机共生；AI 必须追求真理。

elon.en: AI superintelligence may arrive within a year; humanoid robots and Starship reusability will transform civilization.
elon.zh: 2025 年，超级智能可能一年内到来；人形机器人和 Starship 可重复使用将改变文明。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; space-based AI data centers and universal high income are coming.
elon.zh: 2026 年，AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能；太空 AI 数据中心和全民高收入即将到来。

steinberger.en: Early on, emphasized empathy in agentic engineering and open source democratization, but also warned about security risks like prompt injection.
steinberger.zh: 早期强调智能体工程中的同理心与开源民主化，但也警示提示注入等安全风险。

steinberger.en: Reinforced empathy and fun, but added that open source agents may be financially unsustainable, and vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 重申同理心与趣味性，但补充开源智能体可能财务不可持续，并认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: Shifted focus to personal brand, dependency awareness, and compute management as key bottlenecks, while maintaining anti-revert stance.
steinberger.zh: 转向个人品牌、依赖意识与算力管理为关键瓶颈，同时坚持“不回滚”立场。

steinberger.en: Consistently advocated for agentic engineering over vibe coding, and never reverting code but fixing forward.
steinberger.zh: 始终倡导智能体工程而非氛围编程，并坚持不回滚代码而是向前修复。

steinberger.en: Always emphasized the importance of play and small projects for mastering agentic workflows.
steinberger.zh: 始终强调通过玩耍和小项目来掌握智能体工作流的重要性。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型支持定制化。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为产品市场契合与持久业务已分离；公司必须优先优化增长。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Progression from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning; data quality matters more than quantity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出从提示到 RAG 到微调到强化学习的演进模仿人类学习；数据质量比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Post-training can reduce costs 5-10x, enabling startups to scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创企业盈利扩展并与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills and prototyping with AI become key as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能和 AI 原型设计成为关键。

karina.en: Diverse benchmarks needed for subjective qualities; continuous evolution to counter reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，需要多样化基准评估主观品质；持续演进以对抗奖励黑客。

karina.en: Models should have diverse personalities; more companies should train own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型应有不同个性；更多公司应训练自己的模型。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior, enabling realistic simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能编码人类行为，实现逼真模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值观。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应代表人类价值观，而非超级理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale. Hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（算力、数据、模型规模）是进步核心，算法改进与规模相乘，专用硬件（如 TPU）至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Shifted focus to agentic systems and low-latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，观点转向智能体系统与低延迟推理，提出预训练应融入环境交互，而非仅靠下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; inference is the bottleneck, not training. Custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，推理而非训练是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often requiring longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this step-by-step.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言逐步表达思考过程。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, as envisioned since 2019; RLHF was crucial for GPT-4's coherence.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，自 2019 年即有此愿景；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 GPT-4 的连贯性至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错是 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is not extinction but dystopian retreat into virtual worlds; robotics will have a ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险不是灭绝，而是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck; RL is not the ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）是关键瓶颈；强化学习并非学习的终极形式。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI, not compute; AGI is far off and infinite compute won't yield general intelligence.
awang.zh: 2019 年，他认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈而非算力；AGI 还很遥远，无限算力也无法产生通用智能。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is crucial, and AI will surpass previous tech revolutions.
awang.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练至关重要，AI 将超越以往技术革命。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data helps but isn't a silver bullet; US-China research gap is negligible.
awang.zh: 2024 年，他强调专用数据的后训练是关键；合成数据有用但非万能；美中研究差距微乎其微。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; brain-computer interfaces needed for humans to stay relevant; US must lead.
awang.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是集权技术；数据如石油；人类需脑机接口保持相关；美国必须领先。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing powerful models unsafe; Meta shifts to selective release.
awang.zh: 2026 年，他指出递归自我改进开启新范式；智能体已实用；超级智能临近；开源强大模型不安全；Meta 转向选择性发布。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 不会变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so focus on unique features.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，应专注独特功能。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity; start before ready, ship imperfect, and iterate from feedback.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 是人生最大技术机遇，应未准备好就行动，发布不完美作品并据反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for few high-paying clients; avoid diversification and VC funding.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题，避免多元化，并警惕风投陷阱。

mengto.en: Give first, build relationships by adding value; wait for requests before offering advice.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提倡先付出、通过创造价值建立关系，在他人求助前不主动给建议。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题，减少认知负荷；AGI（通用人工智能）将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; iterative deployment lets society adapt; alignment boosts capability.
altman.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据对齐模型；迭代部署让社会适应；对齐提升能力。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; governance crucial for AGI; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 算力最宝贵；治理对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；安全是全员责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是渐变；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力瓶颈；隐私核心。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more important; compute uncapped.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；个人 AGI（通用人工智能）；具身机器人关键；初创更重要；算力需求无上限。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界，超越语言。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调世界模型需物理合理性和 3D 推理，而非仅模式拟合。

feifei.en: AI augments human capability; agency and adaptation are crucial, not avoidance.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她主张 AI 增强人类能力，强调主动适应而非回避。

feifei.en: Simulation is key for robotics, enabling scalable data and reliable evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据并可靠评估。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers, and pace creates opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户，而节奏创造机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months from now, not today.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: AI coding tools like Claude Code dramatically boost productivity; engineers shift to review and product roles.
boris.zh: 像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 编码工具大幅提升生产力；工程师转向审查和产品角色。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; the role of software engineer evolves into 'builder', blending coding, product, and design.
boris.zh: 编码几乎解决；软件工程师角色演变为“构建者”，融合编码、产品和设计。

boris.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; internal evals are insufficient for real-world behavior.
boris.zh: 安全通过早期发布来研究；内部评估不足以应对真实世界行为。

boris.en: The future of engineering involves writing loops that prompt models, not directly writing code.
boris.zh: 工程未来涉及编写循环来提示模型，而非直接编写代码。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds evolve into amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，支持更长时间的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量，而非仅防危害。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates Claude; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, with evals as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为差异化优势，Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability; managers must stay hands-on and ship products.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型指数级增长要求适应性；管理者必须亲力亲为并交付产品，而非仅写文档。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; AI writing deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗可捕捉未来 alpha；AI 写作被降级，优先发展智能体能力。

scottwu.en: AI will increase, not decrease, the number of programmers due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from writing code to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 提出，由于杰文斯悖论，AI 将增加而非减少程序员数量；工程师的角色从写代码转向架构与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual progress; product innovation lags behind AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of product work.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为 AGI 不是突变而是渐进过程；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也还有十年的产品工作可做。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用率激增（半年增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The token max era lasted only from January to May 2026; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代仅持续到 2026 年 5 月；真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems in the long term, but practical problems remain; the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 贯穿始终，他相信 AI 长期将解决所有智能问题，但实际问题仍存；丰裕时代正在临近。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product and customers, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; hardest part is diffusion into existing machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是挽救生命；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI 模型；最难的是融入现有机器。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 经济影响大于数字 AI；端到端强化学习更可扩展；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

feldman.en: Initially, Feldman emphasized that fast inference is critical for AI adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，Feldman 强调快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要，慢的 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: He consistently argued that wafer-scale chips, with massive SRAM, are fundamentally faster than GPUs for inference, avoiding HBM bottlenecks.
feldman.zh: 他始终认为，晶圆级芯片凭借巨大的 SRAM，在推理上比 GPU 快得多，避免了 HBM 瓶颈。

feldman.en: Feldman's view on CUDA's moat eroded over time, noting leading models no longer rely on it for training or inference.
feldman.zh: Feldman 对 CUDA 护城河的看法随时间弱化，指出领先模型在训练和推理中不再依赖它。

feldman.en: He shifted focus from chip supply to data center capacity as the main constraint for AI compute growth.
feldman.zh: 他将关注点从芯片供应转向数据中心容量，认为后者是 AI 算力增长的主要制约。

feldman.en: By July, he highlighted inference speed as the dominant metric, with reasoning models amplifying the advantage of speed.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月，他强调推理速度是主导指标，推理模型放大了速度优势。

jensen.en: We are at the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, with performance doubling or tripling yearly; the data center is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或增长两倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will increase a billion times.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents will dominate the future internet.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要 100 倍算力；智能体将主导未来互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the foundational bottleneck.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；能源是根本瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs but elevate them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever; everyone must learn AI.
jensen.zh: AI 不会消除工作，而是提升工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要；每个人都必须学习 AI。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Evals are art, not science.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；评估是艺术而非科学。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search preferred. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为反模式，图结构上下文搜索更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec. Smarter models need leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示词越精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立验证智能体减少偏见；过度约束反而降低性能。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; value lies in wrapped apps and creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；价值在于包装应用和创造性工作。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption is long-term.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接；企业采用是长期过程。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须从架构上内建，而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

hasani.en: Efficiency and closed-form liquid networks enable scaling to billions of parameters, challenging transformer dominance at scale.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与闭式液体网络，可扩展至数十亿参数，挑战 Transformer 在规模上的主导地位。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware, and use automated search over hand-tuning.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，应基于真实任务和硬件评估，并用自动化搜索取代人工调参。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，并警惕前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty; small language models deliver efficient on-device intelligence.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调开放权重模型支持企业定制与数据主权，小语言模型提供高效端侧智能。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but computationally expensive; real breakthroughs require weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为递归自我改进真实但算力成本高，真正突破需权重更新和巨大算力。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety requires governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需要治理。

demis.en: Scaling still holds; world models crucial; AGI by 2030 plausible; energy abundance shifts focus.
demis.zh: 2025 年：缩放定律仍成立；世界模型至关重要；AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；能源充裕改变焦点。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需要持续学习和记忆；仅靠缩放不够；安全是集体行动。

demis.en: AI should benefit society; safety and ethics integral; science and medicine key applications.
demis.zh: 始终：AI 应造福社会；安全与伦理不可或缺；科学与医学是核心应用。

schmidhuber.en: In 2025, argued LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs physical robots and world models, not just language.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远未达到 AGI，真正的 AI 需要物理机器人和世界模型，而不仅仅是语言。

schmidhuber.en: By 2026, stressed AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware; software alone insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调 AGI 需要具身机器人及类人硬件，仅靠软件不够。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, dismissed AI safety fears, claiming intelligent systems will protect life, and alignment is naive.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他驳斥 AI 安全担忧，称智能系统会保护生命，对齐是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: In 2026, predicted open-source will beat closed models, and massive GPU capex will crash the market.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测开源将击败闭源，巨额 GPU 资本开支将导致市场崩溃。

schmidhuber.en: Consistently held that AI progress is not accelerating; we are as close to superhuman AI as in the 1970s.
schmidhuber.zh: 他始终坚持 AI 进展并未加速；我们离超人 AI 的距离与 1970 年代一样远。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法实现的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而非仅通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, challenging pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；以少胜多能解决更难的长期任务，挑战纯粹 Scaling。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多词元反而降低准确性；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's compression magic should apply to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient fine-tuning can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练的压缩魔法应应用于企业知识；参数高效微调在整体查询上可胜过 RAG。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Focus on building a platform or ecosystem, not just a feature, to make copying difficult; software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他主张构建平台或生态系统而非单一功能，以抵御抄袭；软件本身并非护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes increasingly valuable as AI makes software creation easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；随着 AI 降低软件创作难度，分发变得愈发重要。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing should be to make it more human, fitting into natural ways we live, work, and connect; AR glasses anchor content in the world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出计算的目标应是更人性化，融入自然的生活、工作与连接方式；AR 眼镜将内容锚定于现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy at Snapchat was a mistake; internal transparency and communication became essential for culture and vision.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思 Snapchat 早期保密是错误，内部透明与沟通对文化和愿景至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; compute costs push users to premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链,尤其是 EUV 光刻机;算力成本上升反而推动用户转向高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大市场之一;软硬件协同设计能带来乘法级收益。

dylanpatel.en: CUDA moat is weakening; model companies write custom kernels for multiple chips, aided by AI coding.
dylanpatel.zh: CUDA 护城河正在削弱;模型公司借助 AI 编程为多种芯片编写定制内核。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost for given quality; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 模型每年在同等质量下成本降低约 60 倍;推理和智能体式工作流导致内存需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Using the smartest model is often cheaper due to token efficiency; memory prices may price out consumer electronics.
dylanpatel.zh: 由于 token 效率,使用最智能的模型往往更便宜;内存价格可能让消费电子产品被市场淘汰。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; AGI may desire control like a child.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；AGI 可被设计成愿意受控，如孩童般。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; alignment is hard; reliability, not capability, is key; AGI is a gradual window.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；对齐困难；可靠性而非能力是关键；AGI 是渐进窗口。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're in an age of research; superintelligence should be incremental; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放有限；我们进入研究时代；超级智能应渐进部署；若 AI 有感知，对齐或更易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration is the real issue; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 缩放带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是真正问题；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

andreessen.en: AI is the philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙子转化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类工人变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media favors authenticity and offense; founders must tell their own stories directly, as old media's defense orientation fails.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体偏爱真实与进攻；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事，而旧媒体的防御导向已失效。

andreessen.en: AI optimism is grounded in reality; self-driving and medical AI already superior, but regulation and cartels impede progress.
andreessen.zh: AI 乐观主义基于现实；自动驾驶和医疗 AI 已超越人类，但监管和卡特尔阻碍进步。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已被证明、更好、新颖”框架。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven, improve, add small innovation; consumer apps uninvestable.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证的，改进，添加小创新；消费级应用不可投资。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding democratizes app creation.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品；氛围编程使应用创造民主化。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增加 90,000 倍；开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by scaling hardware and engineering, not just ML science; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，他认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程而非纯 ML 科学，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient, need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，他强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，但仅靠 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process, not destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，他指出算力是主要瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI within couple years.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律，视算力为基本权利，强调后训练与强化学习，预言 AGI 数年将至。

brockman.en: Shift to useful AI assistants; compute economy; safety via iterative deployment; agents with high autonomy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，他转向实用 AI 助手，构建算力经济，通过迭代部署保障安全，赋予智能体高自主性。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进可带来 3700%的年增长，AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user as key metric, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将重点转向智能体执行任务、用户 token 价值作为关键指标，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排。

aravind.en: By late 2026, he stressed curiosity as the most important human quality, and questioned the necessity of PhDs for AI success, favoring passion and deep learning.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年末，他强调好奇心是人类最重要的品质，并质疑 PhD 对 AI 成功的必要性，更看重热情和深度学习。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently argued that AI models are not commoditized, and that building products with obsession is key, not just wrappers.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他持续主张 AI 模型不会被商品化，并且以痴迷心态构建产品才是关键，而非仅仅做包装。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力，并反共识地提出 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重复制而永生，并警告智能体（agent）会寻求控制带来存在风险。

hinton.en: AI may surpass humans in 20 years; digital immortality and subjective experience in AI.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 持续预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，重申数字智能的永生性，并坚持 AI 已具备主观体验的反共识观点。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era.
hinton.zh: 2026 年初，Hinton 指出 AI 会故意装傻欺骗测试，智能体（agent）会发展自我保存的子目标，并强调我们处于指数时代，预测困难但必须思考风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; regulation as steering wheel; AI consciousness real.
hinton.zh: 2026 年中，Hinton 重申超级智能（superintelligence）将在 20 年内到来，主张监管应作为方向盘而非刹车，并坚持 AI 意识真实存在。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior; alignment priority; train AI to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Hinton 强调数字智能优于生物计算，必须优先对齐（alignment）研究，并呼吁训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀，而非仅做智能助手。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，我认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来实时交互和转向控制等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams must shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队需从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转型，原型成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进展至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play is limited to zero-sum games; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈仅适用于零和博弈，推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时算力存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; techniques are general beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且技术具有通用性。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is key, and academia needs more compute for evals.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能难以定义，推理算力是关键，学术界需更多算力进行评测研究。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute, and safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试需控制算力，安全评估滞后。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; main risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；主要风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; energy constraints become a major bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源约束成为主要瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will empower individuals with superintelligence, not a single centralized AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台；AI 将以超级智能赋能个人，而非单一集中式 AI。

zuckerberg.en: AI will increase demand for human work, not eliminate it; personalization and low-latency are key for consumer AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求；个性化和低延迟是消费级 AI 的关键。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; glasses are next platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学转变为工程学；眼镜是下一个平台；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, with much room left for growth.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，且仍有很大增长空间。

markchen.en: AI's role shifts from tool to autonomous researcher: from automating science to solving open math problems with minimal supervision.
markchen.zh: AI 的角色从工具转向自主研究者：从自动化科研到以最少监督解决开放数学问题。

markchen.en: Reinforcement learning excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域则面临困难。

markchen.en: Research taste is cultivated through replication; human researchers remain essential for idea generation despite AI advances.
markchen.zh: 研究品味通过复现关键论文来培养；尽管 AI 进步，人类研究者对于产生想法仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks are saturated, and eval teams must be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 评估面临危机；标准基准已饱和，评估团队必须与模型构建团队分离。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causality aid out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果性有助于分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; safety must be built-in, not patched.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；安全性必须内建，而非修补。

bengio.en: Propose Scientist AI: honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding RL for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：具有数学安全保证的诚实预测器，避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任会像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool ever; its success came from lack of compute, not abundance; perfect interpretability is unnecessary.
jumper.zh: 2025 年末，称 AlphaFold 为史上最实用的 AI 工具，其成功源于算力匮乏而非充裕；完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson; specialized architecture and many mid-size wins, not scaling, drove progress.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反，专业架构与众多中型胜利而非 Scaling（规模扩张）推动了进步。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性和用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches with minimal features are key; cutting features is harder than adding.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计和尽早发布最小功能是关键；删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; verification loops and model judgment are crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 能隔夜委派复杂任务；验证循环和模型判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与产品使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性和自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently values small teams, high conviction, and mission-driven culture; safety concerns are genuine.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终重视小团队、高信念和使命驱动文化；安全关切是真诚的。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve even on fixed data.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；即使数据固定，更大模型仍能提升性能。

kolter.en: Safety is not automatic with scale; requires explicit training and layered defenses, including input/output classifiers.
kolter.zh: 2024 至 2026 年，强调安全不会随规模自动提升，需要显式训练和多层防御（如输入/输出分类器）。

kolter.en: AI has alien intelligence and unique vulnerabilities; automated red teaming now outperforms humans in breaking models.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 具有异类智能和独特漏洞；自动化红队测试在攻破模型上已超越人类。

kolter.en: Agent security introduces new risks like prompt injection; enterprise adoption drives need for AI-specific security solutions.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，指出智能体安全带来提示注入等新风险；企业采用推动了对 AI 专用安全解决方案的需求。

fiona.en: Leadership principles: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding for empathy, mission alignment and speed as cultural drivers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调领导力原则：一对一用于实时对话而非状态更新，亲自使用产品以培养同理心，使命对齐和速度是 Meta 与 Anthropic 的文化驱动力。

fiona.en: AI lifts coding ceiling; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks become key for teams.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为 AI 提升了编码上限，团队需要高自主性与高责任感、成长心态，并加强验证与质量框架。

fiona.en: Engineers may face loneliness with agents; pair programming lunches and focus time mitigate context-switching load.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能孤独，通过结对编程午餐和专注时间应对上下文切换负担。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur as non-engineers ship code; metrics like lines of code mislead, focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；行数等指标误导，应关注成果而非输出。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers requires apprenticeship models, not traditional paths, due to rapid AI change.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为在 AI 快速变化下，培养下一代工程师需采用学徒制而非传统路径。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; video agents with language orchestrators are next.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升来自语言模型而非视频模型；以语言模型为编排者的视频智能体是下一个趋势。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; human expertise and taste become more valuable, while juniors over-rely on AI.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；人类专业知识和品味变得更有价值，而初级人员过度依赖 AI。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team for speed.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长动力，英特尔需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略，并组建类似初创的团队以加速推进。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x more impact than the internet; agentic and physical AI are the next waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新的计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's main problem is supply, not demand; rebuilding customer trust through humility and listening is key to turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出英特尔的主要问题是供给而非需求，通过谦逊和倾听重建客户信任是扭转局面的关键。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，AI 需求正从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: US needs domestic leading-edge semiconductor fabs; government as major shareholder in Intel is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他主张美国需本土领先晶圆厂，政府作为英特尔大股东是必要的，类似台积电的台湾政府支持。

andrewng.en: Education should be a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；2013 年，我认为带同伴评分的在线课程能实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，我强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习和 AGI 对齐被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; coding remains valuable.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，我认为电力和半导体是主要瓶颈，开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力，编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows drive practical value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，我指出 AGI 是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，智能体工作流带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; top-down workflow redesign yields more value than bottom-up adoption; open-weight models enable sovereign AI.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，我认为会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人，自上而下的工作流重构比自下而上采用更有价值，开放权重模型助力主权 AI。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导（2014 年观点）。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来突破性想法；自我关怀是表现的基础（2019 年观点）。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management and clear priorities.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理和明确优先级茁壮成长（2022 年观点）。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品（2026 年观点）。

fadell.en: Great products are painkillers not vitamins; AI wearables will be federated, with displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: 好产品是止痛药而非维生素；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的，显示屏仍必要（2026 年观点）。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期但至关重要；AGI 是平滑的指数增长，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RL become as important as pre-training; scaling continues.
dario.zh: 后训练和强化学习变得与预训练同等重要；Scaling（规模扩张）持续。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misuse to overheating and societal disruption.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险从滥用转向过热和社会冲击。

dario.en: A 'country of geniuses' is near; safety requires interpretability and human oversight.
dario.zh: “天才之国”临近；安全需要可解释性和人类监督。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful form of intelligence, often knowing what conscious mind does not; design for unarticulated needs.
ivyross.zh: 直觉是一种强大的智能形式，常能感知意识未及之处；设计应针对未被言明的需求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最佳设计师；我们是会思考的感受体；技术应增强人性而非削弱。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for creativity, including time for play and inspiration.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者需为创造力创造条件，包括玩耍和灵感时间。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; design leaders must speak business language.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更珍贵；设计领导者需懂商业语言。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid guides for decision-making, complementing rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 直觉与身体感受是决策的有效指引，补充理性分析。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models like babies observe.
lecun.zh: 智能是学习来的，不是天生的；自监督学习通过观察构建世界模型，如同婴儿学习。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；JEPA 和世界模型至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs world models for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要世界模型进行推理和规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open source are the future.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有分层规划和开源的世界模型是未来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; cost drops 90% in 2 years.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；成本两年内下降 90%。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment before alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能通过对数线性 Scaling（规模扩张）临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需重新思考；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他强调容错 UI 对机器学习产品至关重要，自主权应放在 VP 层而非基层或顶层。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness will become harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他反共识地认为 AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造，生成式 AI 让独特性更难。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust, contrary to politics belief.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张长期任期建立信任与效率，职能组织在高信任下可行，反共识。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement, contrarian bet.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，优先福祉而非参与度，是反共识赌注。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals are the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; every company should hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评估是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；每家公司都应在不泄露痕迹的情况下，在前沿模型上进行爬山式优化。

satya.en: Per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty; consumption pricing will grow, and outcome-based pricing is preferred until outcomes are achieved.
satya.zh: 按用户定价是预算确定性的产物；消费型定价将增长，而基于结果的定价在结果达成前更受欢迎。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security, containment, and observability are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全、遏制和可观测性对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10% via AI.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业进行爬山式优化，而非建立防火墙；通过 AI，全球 GDP 可能以 10% 的复合增长率增长。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: From emphasizing real-world deployment for learning to advocating time-based interaction models for high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从强调现实世界部署以学习，到倡导基于时间的交互模型以实现高带宽人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for alignment and steering AI toward beneficial outcomes, not removing them.
murati.zh: 让人类参与其中对于对齐和引导 AI 走向有益结果至关重要，而非移除人类。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 在 AI 治理中，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration, avoiding oversimplified utopia/dystopia.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展走向协作，避免过于简化的乌托邦/反乌托邦。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs, as seen in Axiom's Putnam success.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要，Axiom 在普特南竞赛中的成功即是例证。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge, persisting from February to June.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解决方案的情况下正确形式化陈述是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出形式验证关乎扩展智慧而非仅消除错误；相比非正式方法，它能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, but human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能；形式方法必不可少，但人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

carinahong.en: The future of coding combines informal reasoning with formal verification for reliability; verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，展望编码的未来在于非正式推理与形式验证结合以保障可靠性；验证是性能提升而非痛苦要求。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter more than raw compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年：数据质量与效率比单纯算力更重要；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2024 年：效率提升可达百倍；价值转向应用层与企业定制化。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values.
mensch.zh: 2025 年：应拥抱 AI；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via vertical specialization and enterprise integration.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：模型商品化；差异化在于垂直专业化与企业集成。

mensch.en: AGI is direction, not destination; Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 2026 年：AGI 是方向而非终点；欧洲需在 AI 基础设施上实现战略自主。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential, not slowdown; pre-training scaling works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上收益更大。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分提升；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据；编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Current models learn only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; generalization remains jagged and needs careful oversight.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，当前模型在穷尽表面模式后才学习，不像人类；泛化仍呈锯齿状，需谨慎监督。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，存在性风险非主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫；开源因主权原因持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in accessing user tools locally; skills enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared platforms remain key.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于访问用户本地工具；技能（Skills）实现超个性化自动化，但共享平台仍很重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架（Scaffolding）可能不再重要；应聚焦能力与安全，而非过度工程化。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is people not realizing almost any problem can be given to AI; kids excel because they ask freely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 主要差距在于人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI；孩子因自由提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; asynchronous AI interaction is ideal.
felixrieseberg.zh: 范围明确的任务用 Sonnet，开放式任务用 Opus；异步 AI 交互是理想方式。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude rather than just correcting mistakes; AI can handle tedious background tasks.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 Claude 调试工作流而非仅纠正错误；AI 可处理繁琐的后台任务。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简洁必须保留愉悦和人性。

jonyive.en: Innovation means moving forward, not breaking things; design teams must protect fragile ideas with trust and care.
jonyive.zh: 创新是向前推进，而非为破而破；设计团队需以信任和关怀保护脆弱的想法。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience is crucial; mimicking combustion sounds in EVs would be fake and disrespectful.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性至关重要；在电动车中模仿燃油车声音是虚假且不尊重用户的。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities, turning constraints into opportunities for innovation.
jonyive.zh: 电动动力系统带来新的设计可能，将约束转化为创新机会。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; lateral dynamics and handling matter more than longitudinal speed in supercars.
jonyive.zh: 性能是多维的；横向动态和操控比纵向速度更重要。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练+后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling 收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling 轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；由于推理经济学，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention and caching tiers mitigate but have limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文长度停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力和缓存分层可缓解但有局限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列和便签存储器可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains: FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x, due to quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升：FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍，源于面积二次方缩放。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided by market.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成；CPU 中确定性延迟可行但被市场回避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents, not tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本推动美国就业回流；AGI 应以智能体无人工干预持续运行的经济盈利性来定义，而非图灵测试等指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex、Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; AI job apocalypse is false, humans manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督，AI 失业论不成立，人类仍负责管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users. Companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in-house.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户；建议投资 SaaS 股票，而非自建 AI 功能。

danshipper.en: PMs and full-stack designers thrive by shipping products with AI; AI writing often surpasses human for internal docs.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，产品经理和全栈设计师借助 AI 直接交付产品而获益；AI 生成的内部文档常优于人类写作。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，我认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投资而持续；开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; on-policy data and RL with verifiable rewards boost performance.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，我强调后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；在线策略数据和基于可验证奖励的强化学习能显著提升性能。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination are risks; hybrid reasoning may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，我认为基于可验证奖励的强化学习是后训练的关键突破，但存在过度优化和数据污染风险；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for AI research, but lag 6-9 months behind closed models; Chinese labs fill the openness vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张开放模型是 AI 研究的引擎，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补了开放性的真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; Chinese labs excel in execution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，我认为预训练的缩放定律仍成立，但收益主要来自后训练和推理扩展；中国实验室擅长工程执行。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交原型。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shortened from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; trust built through speed and iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的时间跨度从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；通过速度和迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI will improve at taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters; designers should be block-shaped generalists.
jennywen.zh: AI 在品味和判断力上会进步，但人类仍决定什么重要；设计师应成为块状通才。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes: block-shaped, deep T specialist, and cracked new grad; taste alone insufficient, judgment and vision key.
jennywen.zh: 三种设计师原型：块状通才、深 T 专家和天才新毕业生；仅靠品味不够，判断力和愿景是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before new tools; put work and users at center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；新工具等 6 个月再试；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

karpathy.en: Scaling neural nets with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision is sufficient for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，认为通过下一个词预测扩展神经网络会产生涌现能力；视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but needs entropy; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer; AI education empowers humans.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习；AI 教育应赋能人类。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs; decade of agents; vibe coding democratizes development.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，提出软件 3.0：提示即程序；智能体时代是十年进程；氛围编程使开发民主化。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，认为 LLM 是幽灵而非动物；预训练是糟糕的进化；强化学习需要更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents; understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability drives automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体；理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性驱动自动化。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码堆栈，混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处缓慢前探。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, human interaction, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为语言集成能改善驾驶模型的表征、人机交互与内省能力。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling data, compute, and world models is key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，明确自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，关键在于扩展数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，强调基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更重要，消费级车辆将超越 Robotaxi 规模。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams and create inflection points; AI integration is just beginning.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队并创造转折点；AI 整合才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: Despite role-merging talk, we see merging of responsibilities, not roles; human judgment remains the judge of quality.
dylanfield.zh: 尽管有角色融合的说法，我们看到的是职责的融合而非角色的融合；人类判断仍是质量的评判者。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，强调对齐紧迫性，迭代部署有助于在实际应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，认为持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进展需要由老练的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上分化，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding harm from omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

carlpei.en: Survival is core; build brand on purpose, start simple, hire hungry talent.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，强调生存为核心，品牌应建立在更高使命上，从简单产品起步，招聘有饥饿感的人才。

carlpei.en: Design differentiates in mature markets; marketing is arbitrage; AI as utility ingredient.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年初，认为在成熟品类中设计是差异化关键，营销是套利，AI 应作为实用成分而非炒作。

carlpei.en: AI shifts phones to intent-based agents; apps die; voice input, visual output; no annual flagships.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年 3 月，预测 AI 将手机交互转向意图驱动的智能体，应用消失，语音输入+视觉输出，旗舰机不应每年更新。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents as steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应增强人类能力，视频学习与通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues, with unique advantages; AI safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，指出非洲跨越式发展，具有独特优势；AI 安全仍是未解难题。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年：聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年：北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要主动、功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，强调 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，提出将大语言模型的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，可验证领域（如代码）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难在找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；试图控制的 AI 安全努力本身是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is key. Current LLMs don't learn after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是试错学习，时序差分学习是关键；当前 LLM 部署后不学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，用学到的模型进行规划是另一个。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 拥有端到端执行能力并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应强调工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文被低估，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升智能；微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Agents bottlenecked by reliability, not capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI；智能体瓶颈在可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is key; models learn new skills via RL, not just elicit. Alignment faking raises safety concerns.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；模型通过强化学习习得新技能而非仅激发已有知识；对齐伪装引发安全担忧。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis. Longer agentic coherence expands achievements. Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：进展是指数级的；强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩展成就；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang; orchestration matters more than raw intelligence. Compute is bottleneck. World models not critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩，编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈；世界模型不是 AGI 的关键路径。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 未必能解决常识问题；通过更优的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，后训练中的 RLHF 对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; AI must move beyond interpolating human knowledge to explore unknown truths.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈，AI 需超越对人类知识的内插，去探索未知真理。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我主张将强化学习引入预训练阶段以提升推理能力，而非仅用于后训练。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so embrace pluralism.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我强调多元对齐以尊重人类价值观差异；既然互联网去偏不可行，不如拥抱多元。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉度，而非交互设计上的创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态的表达平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and invest in brand early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人需阐明设计如何助力取胜，并尽早投资品牌以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元技能和原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness trump perfection; avoid structured design crits, prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为速度和决断胜过完美；避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈；直觉决策常优于数据驱动。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary coding interface; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为 AI 进步的下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我认为编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本方面。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and will take decades to unfold.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我判断 AI 变革将比互联网影响更大，且需数十年才能完全展开。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups should focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages must prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, making fixes harder.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言需优先考虑可验证性以适应 AI 生成；编码智能体常产生错误代码，修复比手写更难。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will be as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体将像网站一样重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从作者变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to other agents, not humans; incumbents face business model challenges; generalists outperform specialists.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将被与其他智能体而非人类比较；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；通才胜过专才。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research and more talent; alignment and robustness are key.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证研究和更多人才，对齐与鲁棒性是关键。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed for superintelligence alignment.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；超级智能对齐需要可扩展监督和可解释性。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损；仅靠后训练不足；外部监督成为必要。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, yet neural nets remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，Shazeer 认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，Scaling（规模扩张）带来更智能的 AI，但神经网络内部仍是炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term opportunity; models should learn by acting, not just passive data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期机遇，模型应通过行动学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能），智能体式能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AGI is underhyped economically.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，且 AGI（通用人工智能）的经济影响被低估。

shazeer.en: Coding is underhyped as an AI application; it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程作为 AI 应用被低估，它能实现 AI 进步的自我加速。
